title: Backup, restore, and upgrade rollback drill
goal: Prove that AegisPT can be safely operated through backup, restore, migration, and rollback without losing evidence or corrupting audit history.
scope: Add a documented and tested backup/restore/upgrade drill for local and Compose installs. Include database backup, evidence/artifact storage backup, config/env backup, encrypted secret metadata handling, restore verification, Alembic migration preflight, rollback notes, and a post-restore integrity check. This complements GDPR export/delete and evidence integrity tasks; it is operational resilience, not data-subject export.
generation_reason: Enterprise readiness requires disaster recovery and upgrade rollback proof. Existing docs mention backup paths, but no repo-backed task proves a full backup/restore/rollback drill with evidence and migration validation.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Backup/restore/rollback drill only. Do not redesign storage, introduce managed cloud dependencies, or expose secrets in logs or exports.

success_criteria: A documented backup command/path exists for database, artifacts, reports, env/config, and migration state.
A restore drill can recreate a small seeded engagement with runs, findings, evidence metadata, and audit events intact.
Post-restore verification checks health, schema head, evidence hash availability, and key UI/API read paths.
Upgrade preflight and rollback instructions are explicit and tested at least in local/Compose mode.
No plaintext secrets are included in backup logs or support artifacts.
Results are recorded under codex/results/ with exact commands and pass/fail evidence.
must_not_touch: finding schema fields unless explicitly justified by restore verification

acceptance_criteria: A safe fixture can be backed up and restored with evidence metadata intact.
Operators have one clear runbook for backup, restore, upgrade, and rollback.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Data-subject export/erasure features already covered by backlog-96
